Use in package.json:
  "@gospelo/mermaid-arch": "file:vendor/gospelo-mermaid-arch-0.1.0-3bd1340.tgz",
  "mermaid": "12.3.0"

The tarball does not contain Mermaid. mermaid-arch depends on mermaid 12.3.0
(exact) and reads node_modules/mermaid/dist/mermaid.min.js, which npm ci
installs from the public registry. That bundle contains elkjs (EPL-2.0), so it
is kept out of this repository: it exists only in each user's node_modules.
mermaid-arch checks the installed version and the file's sha256 against its
src/mermaid-manifest.json and stops with an error when they differ.

The tarball holds Font Awesome Free 6.7.2 (fonts OFL-1.1, icons CC BY 4.0,
code MIT).

The integrity value above must match the one npm writes to package-lock.json.
Replace this file together with the tarball when updating to another commit.
